description: This file provides a helper function to resolve URLs for specific auth endpoints, overriding default behavior to route certain paths to an external domain. It defines a function 'resolveAuthEndpointUrl' that examines the given path and base URL to determine whether to force the external domain based on predefined regex patterns, or to construct a URL using the provided base URL.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Resolves a full URL for auth-related endpoints, forcing external routing for specific paths, otherwise constructing URL based on given base URL.
